title: Claims process flow
question: Where do claims wait, which steps send them back, and which open claims will breach their deadline?
story: {open} claims are open; {at_risk} of them may breach their deadline.
questions: Which step adds the most waiting time?
Why are claims sent back from review?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, c.step, c.age_hours, c.breach_risk, k.variant, k.region FROM main.operations.claims_flow_out AS o JOIN main.operations.claims_flow_out__cases AS c ON c.case_id = o.entity_id JOIN main.operations.claims AS k ON k.claim_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: moves
datasets.sql: SELECT t.from_step, t.to_step, t.cases, t.median_hours, t.p90_hours, t.rework FROM main.operations.claims_flow_out__transitions AS t

datasets.name: cases
datasets.sql: SELECT c.case_id, c.step, c.age_hours, c.breach_risk, k.variant, k.region FROM main.operations.claims_flow_out__cases AS c JOIN main.operations.claims AS k ON k.claim_id = c.case_id

charts.title: How claims move between steps
charts.hint: Each arrow is a move: thicker means more claims, red means slow, dashed means sent back.
charts.so_what: Click a step to list the claims waiting there, then expedite or reassign the ones at risk.

charts.title: Slowest steps
charts.hint: Hours the slowest 1 in 10 claims spend before they leave each step.
charts.so_what: The top step is where an extra hand saves the most time.

charts.title: Claims sent back
charts.hint: Claims each step sent back to an earlier step.
charts.so_what: A step that sends many claims back needs a clearer checklist upstream.

y.label: Claims sent back
y.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN rework THEN cases ELSE 0 END)

charts.title: Age of open claims by claim type
charts.hint: The box holds the middle half of the claims; the line in it is the median.
charts.so_what: A claim type with a long box is unpredictable: give it its own deadline.

records.title: Open claims at breach risk
records.hint: Click a step on the process map to list the claims waiting there; the ★ choice follows the suggested action.
records.label: entity_label
